records.title: 10-K
records.text: We experienced a 15.3% decrease in total revenue during fiscal year 2022, primarily driven by our license and connected services revenues.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We have existing relationships with all major OEMs or their tier 1 suppliers, and while our customer contracts vary, they generally represent multi-year engagements, giving us visibility into future revenue.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As of September 30, 2022, our net working capital, excluding deferred revenue and deferred costs, was $146.1 million.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During fiscal year 2022, total cost of revenues decreased by 3.9%, primarily driven by the decline in license and connected services revenues.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities increased by $29.6 million, or 66.1%, from $44.8 million to $74.4 million.
